# Framework schedules

These calls select existing framework workflows. Pick [vLLM](vllm/README.md), [SGLang](sglang/README.md), [ATOM](atom/README.md) or [cross-framework comparisons](common/README.md).

The matching [execution directories](../../frameworks/README.md) explain installation and workload meaning. Client groups, model inputs and acceptance rules stay outside the schedule files. A configured cadence is not evidence that its remote model or GPU run has succeeded.

Return to the [workflow source guide](../../README.md).
